newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Adecco sees sustained dividend level.
newsitem.headline: Adecco sees sustained dividend level.

text.p: Franco-Swiss temporray employment group Adecco SA said it believed it could maintain its current level of dividends with no sharp jumps.
Chief financial officer Peter Pfister told a news conference he expected Adecco to maintain the level of five Swiss francs per bearer share proposed as payamnet on 1996 results.
"We believe it is pay-out ratio we can sustain. We may flatten it out," Pfister said, without specifying the time frame for his forecast.
Asked to elaborate, Pfister said the proposed dividend of five francs was unlikely to be reduced. With respect to any potential increase, it was unlikely that there would be a large jump, he said.
"For instance, it is unlikely to go from five to 15," Pfister added.
